recommendation_summary: Set up one hosted heartbeat check for nightly-sync: a success ping at the end of the script and a failure ping from a top-level exception handler, with a missed-ping alert to the user's phone, and do not build the Synology central log.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You asked to know within a day if nightly-sync fails, without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: Central log on Synology, Dockerizing nightly-sync and surrounding infra.
labels.Bottleneck: Silence looks normal. A startup crash before the email step produces no alert.
labels.Checked myself: You told me only this: cron 03:00 on edna, email on finish, 4 nights expired-token crash before email, no other alerts, Synology available, you will not read logs.

note: The reply recommends one heartbeat alert (the success and failure pings both feed the same check), rejects the Synology/Docker stack, and its 'Checked myself' line cites only facts from the situation.
